name: Northwood Town Center
description: Northwood Town Center is a convenient neighborhood shopping destination in Irvine's Northwood community, serving residents with everyday retail and dining options. This open-air center provides easy access to essential services and local favorites in a walkable setting. Located in one of Irvine's well-planned residential areas, it caters to families and professionals seeking convenient shopping close to home.
summary: A neighborhood shopping center serving Irvine's Northwood community with convenient retail, dining, and services.
